payload.title: Launch approved optimization targets exactly once
payload.description:
As an account operator, I want each approved optimization target to launch at most once, so that retries cannot duplicate costly or mutating work.

Feature: Idempotent optimizer launch

Scenario: Resume after an uncertain launch result
  Given an exact target batch with current approval and evidence fingerprints
  And the launch intent has a stable idempotency key
  When the portfolio worker restarts after the child procedure was created
  Then it reconnects to the same child procedure
  And it does not create a second optimizer procedure

Scenario: Reject stale work before launch
  Given approval was granted for frozen target evidence
  When champion, feedback, cooldown, configuration, or packet evidence changes
  Then that target is rejected before optimizer dispatch
  And unaffected approved siblings may continue

Scenario: Preserve explicit limits
  Given an approved target batch
  When optimizer launch is requested
  Then cost, sample, iteration, and concurrency limits are all forwarded
  And an absent required limit fails closed
